{{Top|leg}}
'''Farson''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] whose business took him to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At some point, an individual attempted to bluff some guards into believing that he was Senator Farson's personal assistant despite not wearing the correct uniform or knowing the required password.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Farson was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]'' published in [[2001]]. The character's name was used to illustrate an attempt by a high-level [[Noble/Legends|noble]] character to convince guards to let them pass using the Bluff skill.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
